book-squares.title: CHRISTIAN FOUNDATIONS
book-squares.subtitle:
A pivotal class for every Christian high school student. Learn:

  • who God is
  • what does it mean to be human
  • What the Bible is
  • What the Bible's message is
  • How has God designed the content of the Bible's message to give us a foundation upon which we can confidently build our lives.
